case.title: Four submissions on one device, all from the same enumerator

submissions.open_text: The hand pump near the school breaks every few weeks and repairs are slow.
Children fetch water from the stream before school and miss lessons.
We pay twenty shillings per jerrycan when the delivery rider comes.
Our landlord fenced off the communal standpipe and now charges a fee.
Water pressure is weak in the evenings but the supply is reliable.

case.why: dev-n2 carries 4 submissions, but every one is from E02, so it has 1 distinct contributor, below the threshold of 2. P02 works on its own device, dev-p02, even though one of P02's submissions falls on the same day as s3. A wrong implementation that counts submissions or rows per device (4 >= 2) would fire. So would one that compares devices across contributors working on the same day. The other checks stay quiet: E02's submissions are on 4 separate days, so there is no same_spot or burst. All points are inside Nyalenda, durations are 1380-1610 s (above 720 s), and times are daytime.
